annotations.text: HOMEPAGE — one CTA repeated, no pricing, no signup. This page has one job: make a factory owner pick up the phone. Sales-led, tech visits the factory.
DASHBOARD — the manager's morning: floor starting up, machines coming online one by one. MAKE NEXT is the day's first decision. Big numbers readable from a metre; every touch target 44px+.
Try the Brand accent tweak (chip above each artboard) — amber is the working pick; green/blue/red are there to compare.
